name: 32-boot-night-lit-room-falls-back
incident: guard for 31: the silent boot measurement must not turn a lit room into night
description: The counterpart of scenario 31: the camera restarts in night mode in a room that is actually lit. With the LEDs off the scene still reads 2300 against 2498 lit (r = 0.92), so the illuminator is not what makes this light and the silent probe cannot confirm night. The boot measurement must then do what it always did - switch to the day pipeline and read it - and finding 600 there (below day_gain 768) it stays day. The expected log pair proves the fallback was taken and that the day verdict came from the audible probe, not from the silent ratio.

expect_log: boot: silent measurement is not a clean night
forbid_log: boot: night confirmed by the silent probe
